items.title: It Walks By Night by Henry Kuttner
items.description: Henry Kuttner, both independently and in collaboration with his wife, the great science fiction and fantasy writer C. L. Moore, was one of the  most important science fiction writers of the 1940s. More than almost any of his contemporaries, he pushed the genre beyond its technological concerns, using sociological and psychological insight to make science fiction a deeply human form of literature. items.title: PLL - Phase and Frequency Detector
items.description:
This video is about phase and frequency detector. These kind of circuits are used in Phase Looked Loop or PLL to detect the different phase or frequency between two input signals producing an error signal to lead the Voltage Controlled Oscillator or VCO.

morning_soundtrack.title: Danz CM Announces New Album The Interdimensional Extraterrestrial Time Travelers Society: Hear Two Tracks
morning_soundtrack.snippet: Danielle Johnson kicked off the year with the release of MYTHS , an ambient album made with vintage synths, recorded live at the Vintage Synthesizer Museum. She returned last month with two new tracks that previewed a new Danz CM era. Now, the 2010 Stereogum Artist To Watch is announcing her new LP, The Interdimensional Extraterrestrial Time Travelers Society .

morning_soundtrack.title: Sabrina Carpenter Cast As Ginger Rogers In Fred Astaire Biopic
morning_soundtrack.snippet: Before Sabrina Carpenter was a singer, she was an actress, best known for her role in the Disney sitcom Girl Meets World .
